title: astracantha echinus
intro: Astracantha echinus, commonly known as Thorny Acacia or Needle Bush, is a plant species native to Africa and the Middle East, characterized by its thorny stems and bright yellow flowers. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Astracantha echinus include its ability to soothe digestive issues, alleviate pain, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
